panels.title: ABOUT SSL
panels.copy: Supersonic Showdown League is an organized competitive Rocket League 2v2 league built around weekly competition, team identities, standings, player profiles, season statistics and official match results.

panels.title: WATCH LIVE
panels.copy: Official featured league broadcast: Saturday at 9:30 PM ET. Follow the channel and enable notifications so you do not miss match night.

panels.title: JOIN THE LEAGUE
panels.copy: Registration, scheduling, league operations and community communication are handled through the official SSL Discord: https://discord.gg/efdQJsceKb

channelTrailer.script: Welcome to the Supersonic Showdown League. Six divisions. Organized Rocket League 2v2. Weekly match nights. Real teams, standings, player statistics and a season that actually means something. Featured league matches are broadcast here every Saturday at 9:30 PM Eastern. Want to compete? Join the league through our Discord. Want to follow the season? Visit showdown2v2.live. This is the Supersonic Showdown League. Play. Report. Climb.
